improvements.rationale: A compelling meta description improves click-through rates from search results by clearly stating the product value and free trial offer. Open Graph tags ensure professional, branded previews when the homepage is shared on LinkedIn, Twitter, or Facebook—critical for B2B audiences. Including the three free searches highlights low friction to try, boosting conversions from social traffic.

improvements.suggestion:
Hero Headline: "Meet Gideon — Your AI-Powered Trade & Business Assistant"

Subheading: "Get instant answers, voice chat support, and a dedicated workspace built for professionals. Try three free searches — no credit card required."
improvements.rationale: This copy clearly introduces the product name and its core function (AI assistant for trade/business), highlights three key value props (instant answers, voice chat, workspace), and immediately communicates the low-friction trial offer. The 'no credit card required' implication from free searches reduces hesitation and drives conversions.

improvements.suggestion:
Q: What happens after my three free searches?

A: Once you've used your three complimentary searches, you'll be invited to become a GDN AI member to continue accessing Gideon. Membership starts at just US$2 per day, billed monthly—or save 30 percent with an annual plan. As a member, you unlock unlimited searches, voice chat, and a dedicated workspace built for trade and business professionals.
improvements.rationale: This FAQ directly addresses the most common friction point in the conversion funnel—what happens when the free trial ends. By clearly explaining the paywall and immediately reinforcing value (unlimited access, voice chat, workspace) alongside transparent pricing, it reduces uncertainty and builds trust, making visitors more likely to convert.
